lines.en: I decide to spend the night hanging out in the dark with Yasu.
lines.zh: 我决定今晚就摸黑跟 Yasu 待在一起。

lines.en: I ask her to turn the lights on because I feel incredibly uncomfortable just watching her stand there smiling, but she refuses.
lines.zh: 我让她把灯打开，因为光看着她站在那儿对我笑让我极不舒服，可她拒绝了。

lines.en: Apparently, even artificial light stings her eyes and it isn't just the sun that manages to do that.
lines.zh: 显然，连人造光都刺痛她的眼睛，不只是太阳才有这本事。

lines.en: My discomfort grows, but is quelled by the fact that, unlike some of the other residents of this dorm, she does not possess any weapons.
lines.zh: 我的不适在增长，不过被一个事实安抚了：跟这宿舍里另外几个住户不同，她身上没有任何武器。

lines.en: That being said, I absolutely would not be surprised if there were some weird religious ritual tools tucked away under her bed or something like that.
lines.zh: 话虽如此，要是她床底下藏着什么奇怪的宗教仪式用具之类的东西，我是一点都不会意外。

lines.en: I make it through the night without dying, which is a thing a lot of unfortunate people out there aren't able to say.
lines.zh: 我熬过了这一夜没死——外面很多不幸的人可说不出这句话。

lines.en: Yasu probably makes it through the night without dying as well, but I can't say that definitively as I'm not there to watch her fall asleep.
lines.zh: Yasu 大概也熬过了这一夜没死，不过我没法确定，因为我不在那儿看她睡着。

lines.en: For all I know, she could be sacrificing herself right now in the name of her god.
lines.zh: 说不定她这会儿正在以她神的名义把自己献祭掉。

lines.en: But I'm just going to assume that doesn't happen and hopefully run into her again tomorrow.
lines.zh: 不过我就当那不会发生，然后指望明天还能再撞见她。
